title: Mosslings
description: This is a Mod that adds the Mosslings, which are small Creatures found in Swamps that resemble Moss alongside a bunch of things related to them.
body:
This Mod revolves around the Mosslings! Find their nests in any swamps and watch as they roam around the world freely! They can be attacked (although they will fight back!) or tamed with Moss and captured with a Mossling Capsule! There are Advancements, an Armor Set and even a brand new Boss all based on the Mossling. To find the boss you need to find the Altar first, interact with the Elder Mossling Nest within it and face the Elder Mossling! Killing it even gives you a Mossling Staff, which you can use to summon Mosslings! Find the secret Button when interacting with an Elder Mossling nest to face a stronger version of it! Defeating it grants a Golden Statue to show off your accomplishment! 

There are Multiple Variants of the Mosslings such as Flying Mosslings, Shiny Mosslings and even Mossling Golems which get created when Mosslings attack Iron Golems.

The specific Content as of V.1.0.4 is the following:

-16 Advancements                                                                                                                                                                 

-4 Pieces of Armor / 1 Armor Set

-6 Blocks

-3 Structures

-1 Tool

-6 Mobs

...and more!

This Mod was created using Mcreator and is my second proper Mod, so please keep in mind that bugs can always pop up!

Shoutout to ThePatchWorkMonster for providing Ideas and the voice of the Mosslings! She makes great art!
